answer.scoring_method: Predicted prioritization score = ESM-2 masked-marginal delta + ln(2) × homolog-PSSM delta_bits + 0.25 × BLOSUM62 score + 0.20 × ESM-IF backbone-conditioned total log-likelihood delta. Larger is predicted better. These are model-based priorities, not measured assay outcomes.
